title: Cinnabar_Island
lead_summary:
This town is accessible from Route 20 or Route 21, or by the Seagallop Ferry.
Players can challenge Blaine for the Volcano Badge, but only if they went through the Pokémon Mansion.
Once the player has found the coordinate to Birth Island, the sailor in the harbor can bring them there.

items.name: Burn Heal
items.location_details: Hidden in the trash bin in the house left of the Poké Mart.

items.name: Metal Coat
items.location_details: Exchange one Metal Powder and ₽5,000 in the house left of the Poké Mart.

items.name: Burn Heal
items.location_details: In a rock to the left of the Pokémon Mansion.

items.name: Super Rod
items.location_details: Given by the Fishing Guru in the ship off the southeast coast.

items.name: Metal Powder
items.location_details: Given by the Scientist in the hotel as a reward for giving her a Quick Powder.

items.name: Helix Fossil
items.location_details: Given by the Hiker in the hotel as a reward for giving him a Diamond Necklace if the player chose the Dome Fossil at [[Mt. Moon]].

items.name: TM104 Recover
items.location_details: Given by the Rich Boy in the hotel as a reward for giving him a Relic Vase.

items.name: Infinite Splicers
items.location_details: In the laboratory, after defeating R.E.D. robot.

pokemon1Ability=[[bulbapedia:Wonder Guard (Ability)|Wonder Guard]] | pokemon1Move1=Endeavor | pokemon1Move2=Vacuum Wave | pokemon1Move3=Shadow Sneak }} == Points of Interest == ===Lab=== On the southwestern edge of the island is a lab. ====Reviving Fossils==== In the rightmost room is a Scientist who can revive any [[bulbapedia:Fossil|fossil Pokémon]] instantly. ====Ancient Power Move Tutor==== In the rightmost lab is a Scientist who will teach [[bulbapedia:Ancient Power (move)|Ancient Power]] to the player's Pokémon for {{P$}}2,000. ====Robot Battles==== In the leftmost room is a robot that looks like [[bulbapedia:Red_(game)|Red]] and is designed to participate in Pokémon battles. By talking to the Scientist next to it, the player can fight the robot. After defeating it, the player will receive the {{ItemIcon|INFINITESPLICERS}} Infinite Splicers. After defeating both the R.E.D. robot and the [[Elite Four]], the room will contain three more robots. If the player is able to defeat all of the robots, the Scientist in the middle of the room will give the player the {{ItemIcon|INFINITEREVERSERS}} Infinite Reversers as well as upgrade the {{ItemIcon|INFINITESPLICERS2}} Infinite Splicers to inherit the highest level like {{ItemIcon|SUPERSPLICERS}} Super Splicers do. === Earth Power Move Tutor === The Pokémon Ranger in the Pokémon Center will teach [[bulbapedia:Earth Power (move)|Earth Power]] to the player's Pokémon for {{P$}}3,500. === Stealth Rock Move Tutor === Inside the boat at the eastern dock there is an Ace Trainer who is invisible. If the player interacts with him, he will appear and teach [[bulbapedia:Stealth Rock (move)|Stealth Rock]] to the player's Pokémon for {{P$}}4,000. === Pokémon Psychiatrist === [[File:PokémonPsychiatrist CinnabarIsland.png|right|thumb|The Pokémon Psychiatrist]] Off the southwest coast is a small island with a single house, reachable by surfing west from the south harbor. In the house is the Pokémon Psychiatrist who in exchange for ₽3000 will change the Nature of one of the player's pokémon to a random one. ==Trivia== ''Team Rocket has stolen the Seagallop Ferry.
